title: 🛡️ Sentinel: [CRITICAL] Fix NoSQL Injection in authentication
body:
🚨 Severity: CRITICAL
💡 Vulnerability: The `authenticateUser` and `io.use` middlewares extracted auth tokens from `req.query`, `req.headers`, or `socket.handshake` without verifying their type. This allowed an attacker to pass a NoSQL injection payload (e.g., `?api_key[$ne]=1`) making the `token` an object, which bypassed truthy checks and was passed directly to MongoDB via Mongoose `Session.findOne({ token })`, potentially returning an active administrative session.
🎯 Impact: Complete Authentication Bypass / Unauthorized Access
🔧 Fix: Enforced input validation ensuring `token` is always parsed safely as a string before evaluating it or passing it to the database driver. Added sanitization for both REST and Socket.io endpoints.
✅ Verification: Ran unit tests and a custom verify script that confirmed that passing an object payload results in the appropriate failure response.
